say:2:1310401001:1.text: What's a masquerade ball like? Chippy's never been to one before... Do we have to wear weird clothes and paint our faces all crazy?
say:2:1310401001:1.source_cn: 化装舞会是什么样的？满满还从来没有参加过……嗯，是不是...

say:3:1310401002:1.text: Ah, there is no need for any peculiar attire, my friends. Merely something elegant befitting a ball, or perhaps a mask if you so desire.
say:3:1310401002:1.source_cn: 哈哈，不用穿“奇怪的衣服”，只要换套适合舞会的就可以了...

say:4:1310401003:1.text: Wait, dancing with a mask on?

say:5:1310401004:1.text: Indeed. In the aftermath of the Divine War, it was tradition for the people to don Hypogean costumes and parade through the streets during the festival, pursued by an enthusiastic crowd.
say:5:1310401004:1.source_cn: 在第一次神魔战争胜利以后，这里的人会在庆典中打扮成恶魔...

say:6:1310401005:1.source_cn: 这种巡游后来逐渐演变为现在的舞会。而舞会嘛……你们应该...

say:7:1310401006:1.text: So now, attendees wear their finest garments to the ball, while some choose to don Hypogean masks as a nod to tradition.
say:7:1310401006:1.source_cn: 所以现在，参加舞会的人会穿上自己最好的衣服，那些注重仪...

say:8:1310401007:1.text: Oh, so we should get new outfits and masks?
say:8:1310401007:1.source_cn: 这么说，我们也应该准备新的服装和面具？

say:9:1310401008:1.text: If you find yourselves in need of attire or masks, there is a <style="highlight">clothing trader</style> in Cedartown where you may discover something suitable.
say:9:1310401008:1.source_cn: 如果你们需要的话，雪松镇上就有<style=highl...

say:10:1310401009:1.text: And do remember, the ball is to be held at the <style="highlight">southeast plaza atop the highest hill in town</style>.
say:10:1310401009:1.source_cn: 对了，请别忘记，今年的舞会会场设在<style=hig...

say:11:1310401010:1.text: Don't worry, Chippy's got a good memory!

say:12:1310401011:1.text: I must attend to the matter of the undead now, but I shall see you at the ball.
say:12:1310401011:1.source_cn: 我还得为活死人之事奔走，诸位，请允许我先离开。我们舞会再见。

say:13:1310401012:1.text: See you there! We should start preparing our outfits too!
say:13:1310401012:1.source_cn: 嗯，舞会见！我们也要去准备化装舞会的服装了！

say:14:1310401013:1.text: Ah, and one more thing—do be careful. I may be wrong, but...
say:14:1310401013:1.source_cn: ……对了，虽然这些话可能有些多余，但还是请诸位多加小心。

say:15:1310401014:1.text: I cannot shake the feeling that this festival may not unfold as smoothly as one might hope.
say:15:1310401014:1.source_cn: 我有种不太好的预感，总觉得这次祭典不会太顺利……希望只...

say:18:1310401015:1.text: Thank you, Mr. Faramor. We'll be careful.
say:18:1310401015:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，法拉莫尔先生，我们会多加注意的。

say:0:1310404001:0.text: The ball's at the southeast hill. Let's hurry!

say:1:1310404002:0.text: Yes, yes! We can't be late!

say:1:1310404002:0.female: Yes, yes! We can't be late!

say:24:1310425005:1.text: Yes! But there are super rare seven-petaled ones too. In Whiteridge, the seven-petaled sapphirine blossom is a symbol of <style="highlight">"miracles"</style>—it's like a sign of the ancient heroes' will.
say:24:1310425005:1.source_cn: 是呀！但是也有七瓣的蓝绒花。在白山，七瓣的蓝绒花是<s...

say:25:1310425006:1.text: My history tutor used to say that the war against the Hypogeans was an impossible war to win.
say:25:1310425006:1.source_cn: 历史老师说，过去与恶魔的抗争非常惨烈，几乎是不可能赢的战争。

say:26:1310425007:1.text: The heroes had no chance, until a miracle happened.
say:26:1310425007:1.source_cn: 但是，“奇迹”发生了——古代的英雄们最终赢得了胜利。

say:27:1310425008:1.text: So, it's kind of like finding a flower with a seventh petal. It feels impossible, but everyone believes in it.
say:27:1310425008:1.source_cn: 在渺小得可怜的概率下战胜恶魔，与在几万分之一的概率下生...

say:28:1310425009:1.text: And hey, who doesn't need a little bit of luck sometimes?
say:28:1310425009:1.source_cn: 毕竟，谁不需要一点好运呢！

choice_prompt:29:1310425009.text: And hey, who doesn't need a little bit of luck sometimes?

say:31:1310425011:0.text: I'll be waiting for you with my father at the ceremony site!
say:31:1310425011:0.source_cn: 我和父亲在仪式会场等你们哦！

say:33:1310425012:0.text: Her Highness' suggestion is sound, and the lighting ceremony happens to take place near the Floral Ruins.
say:33:1310425012:0.source_cn: 公主殿下的提议确实很好，正好点火仪式也在遗迹花海附近举行。

say:34:1310425013:0.text: Mr. Faramor, are you coming with us?
say:34:1310425013:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，你要和我们一起吗？

say:35:1310425014:1.text: Yes. In light of the recent events, I must patrol the ceremony site before the lighting commences.
say:35:1310425014:1.source_cn: 嗯，正好，刚才出了那些事，我得在点火仪式前再去会场周围...

say:36:1310425015:1.text: But first, let's get some rest. We'll head out bright and early tomorrow!
say:36:1310425015:1.source_cn: 那么，咱们先好好休息一晚，明天一早就出发吧！

narration:37:1310425016:0.text: The night fades into day, and with the sunrise comes another morning.
narration:37:1310425016:0.source_cn: 月亮和黑夜一同来了又去，太阳升起，你们迎来了又一个清晨
